name: Grain
tagline: AI notetaker that records meetings and turns them into notes and clips.
best_for: Sales and customer-facing teams that review calls
description:
Grain is a meeting recorder and AI notetaker. It records and transcribes video calls, produces summaries, and lets you pull out short clips of important moments so teammates can watch a key part instead of a full recording.

It is mainly aimed at teams that talk to customers, such as sales, product and customer success, where sharing the exact moment a customer said something is useful. Review summaries and transcripts for accuracy before sharing, and tell participants when you record. Supported video platforms, integrations and plans change, so check the official site for current plans.
use_steps: Create an account on the official site.
Connect your calendar or meeting platform as instructed.
Record a meeting and let the transcript and summary generate.
Review the notes and share a clip or summary with your team.
use_cases: Sharing key moments with product teams

name: Supernormal
tagline: AI meeting notes tool that writes summaries and action items from calls.
best_for: Teams that want structured notes without typing them
description:
Supernormal is an AI meeting notes tool. It joins or captures your video calls, transcribes the conversation and produces a written summary with decisions and follow-up items, so you can stay in the discussion instead of typing.

It is useful for recurring team meetings, project check-ins and client calls where a consistent note format helps. As with any automatic notes, read the output before sending it around, because names, numbers and decisions can be mis-heard. Supported meeting tools, templates and pricing can change, so check the official site for current plans.

Link your calendar and video meeting tool.
Run a meeting and let it generate notes.
Edit the summary and share it with attendees.

name: Jamie
tagline: Meeting notetaker that captures calls without a bot joining.
best_for: People who dislike bots joining their calls
description:
Jamie is an AI meeting notetaker from the company behind meetjamie.ai. Its approach, as it describes on its own site, is to take notes from your meetings without a bot joining the call, producing summaries and action items afterwards.

This can suit consultants, founders and anyone who meets clients who may not like a recording bot in the room. You should still tell participants you are capturing audio and follow local consent rules. Languages, platforms and plans change, so check the official site for current plans.

Review the generated summary and action items.

name: Soundraw
tagline: AI music generator for creating customizable background tracks.
best_for: Creators needing background music for videos
description:
Soundraw is an AI music generator that builds instrumental tracks you can adjust. You pick options such as mood, genre or length and tweak the arrangement rather than writing a text prompt for a full song.

It is aimed at video creators, podcasters and marketers who need background music with a specific duration. Licensing terms matter for commercial use, so read them on the official site before publishing. Plans and pricing have changed over time, so check the official site for current plans.
